vo.en: Press your arms here right now.

visual.description: A man points directly at the lens with an intense, focused expression in a dark studio.

vo.en: Find a doorway and jam the back of your hands against the frame as hard as you can.

visual.description: Close up of a man's tensed hands pressing outward against a wooden door frame.

vo.en: Keep pushing hard. Your brain is blasting electrical signals to your muscles, but your arms aren't moving an inch.

visual.description: Abstract digital animation of glowing neural pathways and fast-moving electrical pulses.

vo.en: Wait, this gets even creepier. Keep the pressure for ten more seconds until your shoulders start to vibrate.

visual.description: Extreme close up of a man's shoulder muscles twitching under heavy physical strain.

vo.en: Now, step away into the open and let your arms hang completely loose. Watch as they float up like magic.

visual.description: A man stands in a hallway and his arms slowly rise up to his sides without him moving them.

vo.en: This is the Kohnstamm reflex. Subscribe for the next brain test and comment YES if it worked, now go back and

visual.description: A man looks at his hands in disbelief then looks up to smile and point at a digital button.
